supporting_pages.title: "Create actions with Gemini assistance \_|\_ Dataform \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: You can use Gemini , an AI-powered collaborator in Google Cloud, to generate SQL and Dataform core code inside .sqlx files in Dataform.
Home Documentation Data analytics Dataform Guides Send feedback Create actions with Gemini assistance Stay organized with collections Save and categorize content based on your preferences.
Tips for query generation The following tips can improve suggestions that Gemini in Dataform provides: Provide the SQL action name enclosed in backticks ( ), such as action name .
